channel.title: SSbreakingHeadlines
channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbreakingHeadlines, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Smithsonian Secretary Lonnie Bunch Resigns Amid Administration Pressure
item.description: Lonnie Bunch, who led the Smithsonian for seven years, is stepping down following criticism from the Trump administration.

item.title: What is a good annuity rate in 2026?
item.description: A suitable annuity can secure favorable returns for retirement, but high payouts are not always the best choice.

item.title: Crude oil price approaches $100 per barrel amid ongoing U.S.-Iran tensions
item.description: Oil prices continue to climb as the U.S.-Iran standoff affecting tanker traffic in the Strait of Hormuz shows no resolution.

item.title: Efforts to lower voting age to 16 for local elections gain momentum
item.description: A nationwide movement aims to allow 16-year-olds to vote in local elections. CBS News correspondent Natalie Brand visited several communities to explore the initiative.
